problems.quote: the total (sum of known absolutes ÷ sum of known percentages)
problems.problem: The formula for the total is missing a factor of 100. When percentages sum to 100, (sum of absolutes) ÷ (sum of percentages) yields total/100, not the total.
problems.correction: the total (sum of known absolutes × 100 ÷ sum of known percentages)
problems.verifierReason: Original formula missing factor 100; correction yields correct total when percentages sum to 100.
